board: Adafruit HDC3022 Precision Temperature & Humidity Sensor - STEMMA QT / Qwiic (product 5989; 6-pin header VIN, GND, SCL, SDA, RST, ALERT)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. The model answers trigger-on-demand 0x2400 with T/RH words plus CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0xFF), encoded with TI's T = -45 + 175*raw/65535 and RH = 100*raw/65535, and answers manufacturer ID 0x3781 with 0x3000 + CRC. The driver checks that ID, triggers the measurement, waits 15 ms (12.5 ms typical in LPM0) and checks both CRCs.
